issues.title: [Docs] Checkout local: `npx clients add` pode reescrever o launcher do `install.ps1`
[Bug] npm test no Windows: stub do gateway (cópia de cmd.exe) pode deixar o after-hook falhar com EPERM
[Bug] `records_query` falha após a troca de environment e pode resolver o datastore fora do `TargetModel` ativo
[Contrato/Bug] genexus_worker_reload force=true reinicia o pool e não aplica sourceDir em mode=hard
[OpenCode] Possível divergência quando opencode.json e opencode.jsonc coexistem
genexus_create Transaction auto-seeds a "<Name>Id" attribute that can't be removed; update_visual rollback leaves orphan global attributes
[GX17] `Could not load type Artech.Genexus.Common.Objects.SuperApp` breaks create, save_as, delete, sql_ddl, wwp and not-found resolution
Gateway does not exit on stdin EOF: orphan keeps worker ownership and the next session sees a false "cold start"
[GX17] Full index rebuild stalls silently after `[LITE-ENUM]`; `index force=true` is refused with `AlreadyInProgress`
`genexus_transfer import` reports "no import was attempted" but creates the object with every part empty
[GX17] `genexus_db action=sql_navigation` builds SQL from concatenated node text
KB lease expires about 20 minutes after `select` even with continuous `kb`-explicit calls
[GX17] `specify` of an existing Main procedure: "object not found in the Knowledge Base", `Status: Failed` with `ExitCode: 0`, and `status wait` does not block
Smaller contract gaps: dryRun without target resolution, status wait vs worker timeout, delete preview needs confirm, pathPrefix, callers edges
